description: Save a file from Drive into /tmp/churn-76av6nrv/.local/state/mcps/google/drive/downloads, which you can read, and prove it: the bytes are checked against Drive's own checksum before anything is written, so a damaged download is never saved. For a file no local copy has yet, or one known only by its id. A Google Doc, Sheet, Slides deck or Drawing has no bytes and is exported instead (a Doc as pdf, a Sheet as xlsx, Slides as pptx, a Drawing as png, unless format says otherwise). An earlier download of the same name in that folder is replaced. Returns the file with the saved path, size, sha256, md5 and verifiedBy (exportedAs for a Google file).

file_id.description: The file's id. Takes precedence over path.

filename.description: The saved name; defaults to Drive's, with the export's extension.

format.description: For a Google file only: what to save it as. Empty is its default.

path.description: The file's path under My Drive, e.g. "Reports/summary.pdf".

save_dir.description: A folder inside /tmp/churn-76av6nrv/.local/state/mcps/google/drive/downloads to save into; empty is /tmp/churn-76av6nrv/.local/state/mcps/google/drive/downloads itself.

name: download_file
title: Download a file from Drive
